protocol.admission: A separate inspection cue would need at least three new strict locations on distinct source groups across both editing families, at most two genuine source groups flagged, and a separate fresh replication. Raw readings have no confidence weight.
protocol.comparison: Score a robustly scaled classifier logit alone and the weaker of its response and the direction-adjusted exact sentence ratio. Each reading keeps its own scale. Allow no missing or neighbor-expanded ratio in the two-reading arm.
protocol.fitting: Use 16 separate genuine work maxima. Require a strictly higher response than the second-highest genuine maximum, with a positive floor of 0.1.
protocol.scoring: Select at most one interior run of 3–8 consecutive same-paragraph sentence centers with two measured flanks on each side. Compare the interior median response to the stronger flanking median and require at least two-thirds of interior centers above both flank medians.
